title: Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and methotrexate
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's arthritis and related long-term drug therapy.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for rheumatoid arthritis.

HPI
83 y.o. female presents for routine f/u of rheumatoid arthritis. Pt reports stable symptoms over the last month. She continues long-term methotrexate and folic acid. No new complaints of systemic symptoms or significant flares in the hands or feet.

Medication List
Methotrexate weekly
Folic acid daily

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
MSK: Mild joint swelling noted in MCP joints and MTP joints. No acute erythema or warmth. Range of motion intact.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F.

Assessment
1. Rheumatoid arthritis: Seropositive (RF positive) status. Symptoms stable on current regimen. No evidence of organ involvement.

Plan
1. Continue methotrexate weekly with folic acid.
2. Continue current monitoring.
3. Return to clinic in 3 months for f/u.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: Rheumatoid arthritis with rheumatoid factor, multiple sites, no organ involvement: M05.79 (HCC 93).

distractors.why: Rheumatoid factor and multiple sites are documented: M05.79.
Methotrexate has its own long-term use code, Z79.631.

hccs.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis and Other Specified Inflammatory Rheumatic Disorders
